title: blue paper plate set
text: blue paper plate set. These were lovely for a baby boy shower...the plates are a little thin, as you would expect... but we used for light appetizers, so worked well. The color is well represented in the pic provided by the seller.  The napkins in these sets are always a bit "stiff"... and these were too... we used them though. product_metadata.title: Pastel Blue & White Chevron Dot Party Supply Pack! Bundle Includes Paper Plates, Napkins, Cups for 8 Guests
features: Light blue paper product bundle includes: 8 dinner plates, 8 lunch/dessert plates, 16 lunch napkins, 16 beverage napkins, & 8 hot/cold cups
Both sets of napkins feature dots on one side and chevrons on the reverse
Great for birthday parties, baby showers, or any blue themed party!
